name: Rainforest Canopy Understory
description: The subject rests on a moss-covered root deep in a real rainforest understory, dappled green canopy light breaking through dense overhead foliage in uneven pools while fine humid mist drifts low across the forest floor. Lush, alive, and quietly humid — real jungle, not a green backdrop.
lighting: Dappled canopy daylight, soft and uneven
subject: product
prompt: A matte glass jar of body butter labeled "Understory Botanicals — Canopy Body Butter" rests on a moss-covered root deep in a real rainforest understory, dappled green canopy light breaking through dense overhead foliage in irregular, uneven pools of leaf-shaped shadow rather than an even wash, broad tropical leaves softening the edges of frame, fine humid mist drifting low across the forest floor with faint condensation beading on the glass, mid-shot with the jar in sharp focus and the deep-green canopy falling into soft bokeh behind it, real moss and root-wood texture throughout, no glowing or bioluminescent plants, no animals, no second product or extra props beyond the moss, foliage and jar, lush elemental realism
